link_accepted: Let me look this player up and process their data. It should take about a minute.
provide_link: Please send a transfermarkt link only.
welcome:
Welcome!
Here's how to use the bot:
1) Send me a transfermarkt link to a player you want me to look at.
2) Choose one of the available seasons. I will provide you with an analysis of the player for that season.
3) Use other commands from the menu to get more info. They will only work after a season analysis has been performed for the selected player.
card_no_analysis: You need to generate season analysis before requesting a card.
no_data_this_season: No data for this season in our database. You can request another season through the menu.
selseas_0: {name} is a {pos} who was born {bday} in {country}.
selseas_1:
The following summary is based on the player's performance in {season}.

{name} played in {appearances} matches for {team}, spending a total of {minutes} minutes in the field. {name} scored {goals} goals and made {assists} assists.
selseas_2:
I will be examining his most played position: {pos}. In this position, {name} played for {rminutes} minutes.

Assembling analysis.
av_seasons_0: The following season data is available in our database:
av_seasons_1: The following season data is not aggregated in our database, and may not be present at all. However, I can still try to find and aggregate it:
not_enough_data: Not enough available data for this player.
no_data_stored: No data is currently stored. Send a transfermarkt link to start!
stored_season: Analysis has been previously performed on season {sname} of competition {cname} {cformat}({caname}). All menu commands are functional.
no_stored_season:
No season analysis has been stored for this player. Use /seasons command to select a season.

Note: the bot only remembers the last player and season request. Older data and analysis is not cached.
no_metric: Sorry, I don't think we're tracking that metric for this position.
